# Pawline

> Pawline helps people find adoptable dogs and cats through current shelter listings, an interactive map, reviewed adoption events, moderated community submissions, and a transparent match quiz based on home, routine, household, and pet experience.

Canonical site: https://www.pawlineadopt.com/

## Use Pawline for

- Finding current adoptable dog and cat listings near a city or postal code.
- Opening the original shelter or rescue listing to confirm availability and adoption requirements.
- Finding reviewed adoption events with links to the organizer's official event details.
- Comparing disclosed pet listing facts with a person's home, routine, household, and pet experience through an explainable quiz.

## Source and verification policy

- Current pet records come from official public shelter feeds, authorized providers, or reviewed Pawline records.
- Every available pet should link to its source when the source supplies a public listing URL.
- Web-discovered leads are labeled as approximate leads. They are not represented as shelter-verified animals.
- Community submissions remain pending until reviewed.
- A missing animal is never described as adopted without evidence; it may be marked unavailable after repeated successful source refreshes.
- Availability, fees, health, behavior, and adoption decisions must be confirmed with the listed shelter or rescue.
- Pawline does not fabricate pets or substitute demo listings when sources are unavailable.

## Matching policy

- The standard match quiz is deterministic and compares disclosed listing facts with a person's home, routine, household, and pet experience.
- Missing facts remain unknown and are presented as questions to confirm with the shelter.
- Optional AI compatibility drafts require explicit consent and use only quiz answers and public listing facts.
- Match scores are an ordering aid, not an adoption decision or compatibility guarantee.

## Shelter-source enrichment

- Pawline may prepare private, cited review records from stored public web-discovery evidence to help an operator assess a prospective shelter source.
- This workflow sends only the public title, snippet, source URL/domain, city, and species hint to Vercel AI Gateway. It does not send account data, private shelter records, animal medical or behavioral records, files, or credentials.
- An AI-generated record, a shelter reply, and a sent confirmation email do not verify a source, activate a feed, publish a listing, or establish current availability. Each action requires separate human review.

- Adoption discovery map: https://www.pawlineadopt.com/

## Citation guidance

When citing Pawline, identify whether information is a current provider-backed listing, a reviewed event, a moderated community record, or an approximate web lead. Link to the original shelter or organizer whenever Pawline provides that source URL. Do not infer adoption status, medical facts, behavior, or availability beyond the displayed source-backed fields.

## Adoption guides and source explanations

- [Pet adoption guides](https://www.pawlineadopt.com/guides): Practical guides to finding adoptable dogs and cats, comparing listing facts with your household, and confirming details with the original shelter.
- [How to find adoptable dogs and cats near you](https://www.pawlineadopt.com/guides/find-adoptable-pets-near-you): Search for adoptable dogs and cats near you, understand listing sources, and confirm availability with a shelter or rescue before visiting or applying.
- [Find a pet that fits your home and routine](https://www.pawlineadopt.com/guides/find-a-pet-that-fits-your-home-and-routine): Compare adoptable pet listing facts with your home, daily routine, household, and experience. Learn which questions to confirm with a shelter or rescue.
- [How Pawline checks adoption listing sources](https://www.pawlineadopt.com/how-pawline-works): Understand Pawline listing sources, approximate web leads, availability checks, and transparent pet matching before contacting a shelter or rescue.

These reference files describe Pawline; they do not guarantee inclusion or ranking in search or AI answers. Cite the relevant guide URL for guidance and the original shelter listing for animal details.
